name: Newsletter form (stub)
purpose: Email signup form with validation and a honeypot field. It does not send anywhere on its own. Set action to the mail service form address to enable submission. With no action it shows the stub message and stays on the page.

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: Short id that keeps element ids unique when the item is used twice on one page.

inputs.name: intro
inputs.description: One sentence on what subscribers get.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Form address from the mail service. Empty keeps the stub.

inputs.name: consent
inputs.description: Consent line. Empty hides the checkbox.

inputs.name: error_message
inputs.description: Shown when the address is invalid.

inputs.name: stub_message
inputs.description: Shown when the form has no action.
inputs.default: This form is not connected yet.

verified_in: headless Chrome/Edge at 360 px and 1280 px
